body:
OWNER BREADTH COROLLARY — the WOG recall walkthrough is the first runnable lab, not a sufficient account of a 17-module library. The site needs a capability tour organized by scientific questions, not a module inventory:

1. WHAT DID THE SOURCE SAY? One WOG passage to typed reported/asserted/negated/hypothesized structures, exact evidence spans, context, and open alternatives.
2. HOW DID THE RETELLING CHANGE IT? The current WOG recall pipeline to candidate costs, posterior, Viterbi path, RecallSignature, and the three static plots already specified.
3. WHAT DOES AN AUTOBIOGRAPHICAL INTERVIEW PRODUCE? The public BirthdayInterview fixture through segmentation, detail atoms, target/other/habitual/metacognitive/unresolved addresses, traditional expected and hard counts, placement resolution, and the multidimensional Profile. Show a transcript excerpt, exact code/output, address table, and score/profile plots.
4. HOW ARE EMBEDDINGS USED WITHOUT BECOMING TRUTH? One public baseline batch and one sensitive-policy rejection/success receipt, including per-item abstention/failure. No quality claim. Add ONNX-versus-lexical only after the repository contains the measured comparison.
5. HOW DO RESULTS MOVE BETWEEN TOOLS? Canonical StoryModelCodec JSON round trip plus checksum now; Codex/Atlas output bundle and a filesystem-openable rendered artifact only when the output epic ships.

Each lab owes the same evidence court: runnable public code; captured exact output; one meaningful reproducible visual where the data warrant it; prose interpreting both result and limitation; source/test link at the exact SHA. API/module reference comes after these labs. Automatic raw-text acquisition stays an Intent page until an audited adapter exists; the pure proposal/compiler contracts are not that workflow.

This is the breadth answer to the owners question “we have a big library — what does it do?” It also prevents the getting-started page from carrying the entire burden.
